in_sanskrit.name: Rimjhim
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Tinkling
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Rimjhim एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। A name derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Rimjhim’, which means ‘Tinkling’. The name evokes images of a gentle water stream producing melodic tones as it flows over pebbles.

in_hindi.name: रिम्ज़ीम
in_hindi.long_meaning: The name Rimjhim is derived from the Hindi word 'rimjhima,' which means 'tinkling sound.' It is often used to describe the sound of rain or water.
